gloss: for free; at no charge; free of cost

definitions.gloss: for free; at no charge; free of cost
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is provided or available without requiring payment. Very common in commercial, service, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: このアプリは{無料|むりょう}で{使|つか}える。
examples.english: This app can be used for free.

examples.japanese: {入場|にゅうじょう}は{無料|むりょう}です。
{無料|むりょう}で{体験|たいけん}レッスンを{受|う}けることができます。
examples.english: You can take a trial lesson for free.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{無料|むりょう}で{手伝|てつだ}ってくれた。
examples.english: My friend helped me for free.

notes:
Composed of {無料|むりょう} (free of charge) + で (particle indicating means/manner). {無料|むりょう} can also function as a no-adjective modifier: {無料|むりょう}の{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (free parking lot).

In signs and advertisements, {無料|むりょう} often appears alone without で.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料|むりょう}で{提供|ていきょう}する: to provide for free
- {無料|むりょう}で{利用|りよう}できる: can be used for free
- {無料|むりょう}で{配布|はいふ}する: to distribute for free
- {送料|そうりょう}{無料|むりょう}: free shipping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ただで: for free — more colloquial and casual
- タダ: free — casual katakana spelling of ただ, common in informal writing
- {無償|むしょう}で: without compensation — more formal, used for services and professional work rather than products
